scope: Profile summary and existing policy editors

reference.description: Second-pass Profile capture with Age, Sex, Weight, Height, BMI and Body Fat. The earlier similarly named capture shows Account confirmation and is not the layout reference.

adaptations: The original local app has only generic Profile forms; the compact cloud summary is implemented from the saved second-pass screenshot.
The six summary rows preserve source order and measurement units. Options retain existing Body & Activity, Nutrient References and Recorded Measurements configuration.

Age and Sex display the configured resting-equation inputs, or nutrient-reference inputs if there is no equation. The child editor identifies its policy; it does not silently synchronize distinct policies.
Measurements use exact selected series. Unselected, missing and invalid readings remain distinct. No seed-profile sample values are used. Unconfigured measurements open series selection.
BMI reuses the canonical bodyMassIndex function over canonical recorded kilogram/centimetre values; no new formula or policy schema.
Age/Sex mutations retain unrelated settings and use immutable receipt payloads for ambiguous retries. Revision conflicts require reload.
More passes headerRoot to the separate Display controller as its agreed integration change.

verification.coverage: Production-CSP Chrome, actual More entry point, compact header geometry, exact custom lb record, compound/source record editor reuse, age and sex ownership, immutable503 retry,409 reload, cancel, initial read retry, unknown measurements, late read after Back,320px light and412px dark.

limits: Saved Profile screenshot establishes main row layout. Detailed Cronometer Age/Sex child dialogs were not captured; cloud dialogs use existing canonical policy fields.
Summary follows the requested diary date, matching the existing profile-settings endpoint.
No physical Pixel check in this increment.
